implementation.contract: The questions endpoint accepts at most three prior user questions from the active document. Answers, citations, extracted values, and other-document history are never sent as conversational context.
implementation.retrieval: Direct evidence-backed fields bypass rewriting. Other questions may be rewritten into a standalone retrieval query, receive deterministic licence-domain synonym expansion and reciprocal-rank fusion of lexical and semantic rankings, then remain answerable only from selected immutable blocks.
implementation.safety: The rewrite provider receives question text only, uses strict structured output, no persistence, and no retries. Rewrite configuration, timeout, malformed output, and provider failures fall back to the original question. The answer provider receives the original user question and active-document source blocks only.
